name: matchcut
description: matchcut: agent skills for product films that look made by a studio.

plugins.name: matchcut
plugins.description: Product films from your agent: the real UI recorded at a smooth 60 fps and cut with a virtual camera, a title intro made in code that match-cuts into the product, an original score written in code or a song prompt for any music generator fitted to the cut, and image and video prompts for a generated opening if you want one (MiniMax, Grok, Seedance, Veo, Kling, Wan, Runway, Luma, LTX).
